translations.web: Of a foreigner you may require it; but whatever of yours is with your brother, your hand shall release.
translations.bsb: You may collect something from a foreigner, but you must forgive whatever your brother owes you.
translations.kjv: Of a foreigner thou mayest exact it again: but that which is thine with thy brother thine hand shall release;
